Targets & forecast

Monthly goals split across 4 weeks, matching the workbook

Type a monthly figure and it replaces that month's weekly goals: monthly ÷ 4. Months you leave alone keep the workbook's own week-by-week goals. Clear a cell to hand the month back to the workbook.

Forecast hours drive the Forecasted Hours Variance line, and every week past the last actual week is drawn as a dashed projection on the hours and revenue charts. Pick a horizon and press Extend and fill: the weeks are created and any blank ones are seeded from the monthly target, so you adjust figures instead of typing them all. A seeded week follows later changes to its monthly target; type over one and it stops. Blank projected revenue is estimated at the trailing 8 week bill rate.

 
Seed blank weeks from
 

The Needs List block from the Smartsheet dashboard. Staffing % is calculated from actual hours filled against open hours.

Every Service Line Detail Report uploaded to the hosted site is kept here and merged into one history. Upload whatever date range you have: when two imports both cover a week, the newer upload wins, so a corrected export replaces the old figures without deleting anything.
